title_as_printed: Osmotic and activity coefficients of sodium sulphate in water
pressure_note: pressure measured by transducer; dP (vapour pressure lowering) is the measured quantity; absolute pressure of solution not tabulated

value.what: osmotic coefficient calculated from dP via eq. [1] (vapour-phase non-ideality and compression corrections)

value2.what: measured vapour pressure lowering of solution relative to pure water at the same T

value3.what: mean ionic activity coefficient from the authors' Pitzer fit

conversion_needs: dP in Torr; vapour pressure of pure water at T not tabulated
notes: Largest m in each isotherm is the saturation molality taken from the literature. Table 3 (smoothed values), Table 2 (Pitzer parameters), Tables 4,5 not extracted.
